name: Justice D.Y. Chandrachud
judicial_philosophy: Expansive interpretation of fundamental rights, privacy jurisprudence, transformative constitutionalism

name: Justice N.V. Ramana
judicial_philosophy: Judicial infrastructure reform, mediation emphasis, access to justice

name: Justice R.F. Nariman
judicial_philosophy: Textualist approach, strong proponent of individual liberty and free speech

name: Justice P.N. Bhagwati
judicial_philosophy: Pioneer of PIL jurisprudence, judicial activism for social justice, epistolary jurisdiction

name: Justice Y.V. Chandrachud
judicial_philosophy: Longest-serving CJI, evolved basic structure doctrine, rarest of rare doctrine

name: Justice V.R. Krishna Iyer
judicial_philosophy: Champion of prisoners' rights, bail reform, social justice through law

name: Justice H.R. Khanna
judicial_philosophy: Famous for lone dissent in ADM Jabalpur defending fundamental rights during Emergency. Sacrificed Chief Justiceship for principles.

name: Justice Kuldip Singh
judicial_philosophy: Known as 'Green Judge' for environmental jurisprudence, polluter pays principle

name: Justice J.S. Verma
judicial_philosophy: Vishaka guidelines creator, collegium system architect, anti-corruption crusader. Later chaired Justice Verma Committee on sexual violence (2013).

name: Justice Indu Malhotra
judicial_philosophy: First woman lawyer directly elevated to SC. Notable dissent in Sabarimala — essential religious practices should not be interfered with.

name: Justice Sanjay Kishan Kaul
judicial_philosophy: Intellectual property jurisprudence, technology law, right to privacy

name: Justice A.P. Shah
judicial_philosophy: Delivered historic Naz Foundation judgment reading down S. 377. Later chaired Law Commission of India.

name: Justice K.S. Radhakrishnan
judicial_philosophy: Authored NALSA judgment recognizing transgender rights and third gender

name: Justice Markandey Katju
judicial_philosophy: Authored passive euthanasia judgment in Aruna Shanbaug case. Later chaired Press Council of India.

name: Justice B.R. Gavai
judicial_philosophy: Strong stance on SC/ST Act protections, social justice, judicial accountability

name: Justice Sanjiv Khanna
judicial_philosophy: Clear writing, emphasis on proportionality and due process

name: Justice Dipak Misra
judicial_philosophy: Presided over several Constitution Benches — S. 377, adultery, Sabarimala, living will

name: Justice P. Sathasivam
judicial_philosophy: Mandatory FIR registration. Later served as Governor of Kerala.
